items.title: Storm Boelo leaves 90,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
items.summary: Around 90,000 properties are without power after Scotland and north England is battered by strong winds.

items.title: Met Office issues new weather warning for wind - as two men killed by falling trees
items.summary: The Met Office has issued a new wind weather warning after Storm Boelo pummelled the UK with gusts of up to 84mph, flooded streets and caused power cuts to 800,000 homes.

items.title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month
items.summary: Senior doctors to stage 48-hour walkout, beginning on 25 November, in dispute over pay and pensions.

items.title: Senior doctors to strike for two days in November
items.summary: Senior doctors in England plan to go on strike for two days in November over pay, the British Medical Association (BMA) has said.

items.title: Knighting Sinfield 'easiest decision anyone's had to make,' says Prince William
items.summary: The rugby league star is "gold dust" and "should have been Sir Kevin years ago," says the Prince of Wales.

items.title: London's Oxford Street pedestrianised in 'truly momentous occasion for capital'
items.summary: London's Oxford Street is now traffic-free, with mayor Sadiq Khan hailing it "a truly momentous occasion for the capital".
